filters.operations: owner = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trace_authority a WHERE a.id = :requester AND a.disabled = 0 AND a.can_view_all_traces = 1)
filters.traces: created_by = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trace_authority a WHERE a.id = :requester AND a.disabled = 0 AND a.can_view_all_traces = 1)
filters.spans: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM traces t WHERE t.id = spans.trace AND t.created_by = :requester) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trace_authority a WHERE a.id = :requester AND a.disabled = 0 AND a.can_view_all_traces = 1)
filters.user_directory: id = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trace_authority a WHERE a.id = :requester AND a.disabled = 0 AND a.can_view_all_traces = 1)
